test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0cf2b94472949ff80d7deb4e04380c79daf0cd3cffe2c666733af4df3d420e9.png] 

Logic followed here is:

In each pair, the relationship between the first and second letter-clusters is based on the positional values of the letters. Specifically, the first letter of the first cluster is increased by 7 to get the first letter of the second cluster, and the second letter of the first cluster is increased by 6 to get the second letter of the second cluster.

(1) XV – AC →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c07db7ada41f9ee343170620997f3bdfb3eee0298004faea0de5b9d35a4decf8.png] 

 

For (2) OM – VS →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/361e6e85904fa143a7d2af83007a80c03704a1702521130a45bc3ecca3a4eb98.png] 

 

For (3) DB – KH →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb44eb4cbfac64aee1af8baa3a78039790a80d3488e8bd1617540240d9435d28.png] 

 

For (4) FD – MJ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b14761a2904eb1c461d99dbbdf0b2fe40638c58a2aa7491f20087f22cd210876.png] 

 

Therefore, the letter-cluster pair that does not belong to the group is **XV – AC**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
